title: Quince Semaphore
description: A quick exchange of bright signals passes between the hands. Small chromatic turns enliven the tune; a complete bar of silence opens the way to a chordal response. The familiar descending fragment appears near the end, and the last two chords answer each other across a breath.
technical_note: Maintain one pulse through the alternating hands and the silent bar. Keep the chromatic sixteenth notes light. Release the bright chords completely, including the gap before the final reply.

performance.note: Deliberate dance pulse, shaped phrases and terraced dynamics; no random timing.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
